⚠️ Counter-intuitive finding: FRESH entry quality (buying precisely at support) has WR 36.8% and avg -2.69% — the WORST category. MISSED entries (already moved, chasing slightly) outperform at WR 60.2%, avg +1.35%. Hypothesis: FRESH = buying into supply from weak holders at support; MISSED = confirmation of break above supply. Action: Demote FRESH to WATCH-only, require VALID/MISSED for BUY.

MAE / MFE Analysis — Stop & Target Optimization

MAE Distribution (Max Adverse Excursion)

How far trades went against us before resolving — green=winners, red=losers

MFE Distribution (Max Favorable Excursion)

How far trades went in our favor — green=winners, red=losers

Stop Optimization Insight

Winners' MAE tells you where stops can be set without cutting them:

  • Winners avg MAE: -2.0% (they briefly go against you this much)
  • Losers avg MAE: -6.3% (losers go much further against)
  • Stop suggestion: -3.0% from entry (1.5× winner MAE) as floor
  • 22% of winners dipped below -3% before recovering

Target Optimization Insight

Winners' MFE tells you where to set T1/T2 targets:

  • Winners avg MFE: 6.5% max favorable
  • Losers avg MFE: 2.1% (barely move up)
  • T1 suggestion: +3.9% (60% of avg winner MFE)
  • T2 suggestion: +5.8% (90% of avg winner MFE)
  • MFE > 2% is a strong winner signal — if MFE < 1.5% by day 2, consider early exit
